glyph_origin: The bronze inscription was in the form of 門 (“door”) + 卝 (“locked door; two wooden sticks to lock a door”). 卝 might also serve as a phonetic component. The whole character represents a door locked with two wooden sticks. Then, the character slightly evolved into Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 門 (“door”) + phonetic 𢇅, in which two couples of rings similar to 幺幺 are visible on top of the two wooden sticks.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 關; s_page_origin explains the simplified 关.
